title: Set 236

sentences.ko: 저기요, 부엌 싱크대 밑 수납장에서 물이 샌 지 일주일쯤 됐어요. 밑에 그릇을 받쳐 놓긴 했는데 아침마다 비워야 해서요. 바닥 다 망가지기 전에 누가 와서 좀 봐 주실 수 있을까요?
sentences.text: Hey, so the kitchen sink's been leaking under the cabinet for about a week now. I put a bowl down there, but I have to empty it every morning, so is there any way someone could come take a look before it ruins the floor?

alts.text: Ugh, my sink's been dripping under the cabinet for like a week. I stuck a bowl under it but I'm dumping it out every morning, so can somebody come check it out before the floor's wrecked?

Hello, the kitchen sink has been leaking under the cabinet for approximately one week. I have placed a bowl beneath it, but I must empty it every morning. Would it be possible for someone to come and inspect it before it damages the floor?

sentences.note: **take a look** 는 한번 봐 주다, 살펴보다라는 뜻으로 수리를 부탁할 때 자주 씁니다. **ruins the floor** 처럼 ruin 은 완전히 망가뜨리다라는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 우리 고양이가 내 협탁 위에 있는 물건을 떨어뜨리면 내가 일어나서 밥을 준다는 걸 알아냈어. 그래서 이제 매일 아침 다섯 시에 그래. 계속 그러라고 가르치는 꼴인 건 아는데, 그걸 듣고 그냥 자고 있을 수가 없어.
sentences.text: My cat figured out that if she knocks stuff off my nightstand, I get up and feed her, so now she does it at five every morning. I know I'm just teaching her to keep doing it, but I can't sleep through that.

alts.text: My cat's worked out that knocking junk off my nightstand gets me up to feed her, so now she's doing it at five every single morning. Yeah, I know I'm kinda training her, but I can't sleep through it.

My cat has learned that if she knocks items off my nightstand, I will get up and feed her, and she now does so at five o'clock every morning. I realize that I am only encouraging the behavior, but I am unable to sleep through it.

sentences.note: **figured out** 은 궁리해서 알아내다라는 뜻입니다. **sleep through** 는 시끄러운 일이 있어도 깨지 않고 계속 자다라는 표현입니다.

sentences.ko: 헬스장 갈 준비 다 해 놨는데, 언니가 전화해서 한 시간 가까이 수다 떨게 됐어. 그러고 나니까 도저히 갈 힘이 안 나더라. 내일은 갈게, 진짜야.
sentences.text: I was all set to go to the gym, but then my sister called and we ended up talking for like an hour, and after that I just didn't have it in me. I'll go tomorrow, I promise.

alts.text: Totally meant to hit the gym, but my sister called and we were on the phone like an hour, and after that I just couldn't. Tomorrow, I swear.
I had fully intended to go to the gym, but my sister telephoned and we spoke for approximately an hour, after which I no longer had the energy. I will go tomorrow, I assure you.

sentences.note: **all set to** 는 ~할 준비가 다 되어 있다는 뜻입니다. **didn't have it in me** 는 그럴 기운이나 마음이 남아 있지 않았다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 오늘 샌드위치 하나에 14달러 줬는데, 맛있지도 않았어. 엄청 맛있었으면 그래, 이해하지. 근데 칠면조 고기 두 장에 양상추 좀 들어간 게 다였어.
sentences.text: I paid fourteen bucks for a sandwich today, and it wasn't even a good sandwich. If it had been amazing, fine, but it was like two slices of turkey and some lettuce.

alts.text: Fourteen bucks for a sandwich today, and it wasn't even good! If it'd been amazing, okay, but it was basically two slices of turkey and some lettuce.
I paid fourteen dollars for a sandwich today, and it was not even a good one. Had it been excellent, I would not mind, but it consisted of roughly two slices of turkey and some lettuce.

sentences.note: **bucks** 는 dollars 를 편하게 부르는 말입니다. **If it had been amazing, fine** 은 엄청 맛있었으면 그 값도 납득했을 거라는 뜻으로, fine 한 마디로 그럼 괜찮았지를 대신합니다.

sentences.ko: 네가 말해 준 태국 음식점 드디어 가 봤는데, 네 말이 맞더라. 커리 진짜 맛있었어. 근데 자리 나기까지 거의 40분을 기다려서, 금요일 밤에 또 갈지는 모르겠어.
sentences.text: So we finally tried that Thai place you told me about, and you were right, the curry was really good. But we waited almost forty minutes for a table, so I don't know if I'd go back on a Friday night.

alts.text: Okay, we finally hit up that Thai spot you mentioned, and yep, the curry was super good. We waited like forty minutes for a table though, so I dunno about going back on a Friday night.

We finally visited the Thai restaurant you recommended, and you were correct, the curry was excellent. However, we waited nearly forty minutes for a table, so I am not certain I would return on a Friday evening.

sentences.note: **you were right** 는 네 말이 맞았다고 인정할 때 쓰는 말입니다. **go back** 은 어떤 가게에 다시 가다라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

reviewed: 2번 한국어 마지막 문장 '그 소리에 계속 잘 수가 없어'가 번역투라 '그걸 듣고 그냥 자고 있을 수가 없어'로 고침
4번 note가 If it had been amazing, fine 을 '아쉬워하며 가정'으로 설명했는데, 실제 뜻은 '맛있었으면 그 값도 납득했을 거다'라서 설명을 고침
